content.text:
I've submitted **index 5 (Ba 0.49 / Mn 0.51)** as the best composition. It gave the highest photocurrent of the three I measured, 2.95 µA.

| Index | Ba fraction | Photocurrent |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0.17 | 1.07 µA |
| **5** | **0.49** | **2.95 µA** |
| 20 | 0.61 | 0.04 µA |

The merit budget allowed only 3 measurements across 29 candidates, so I spread them along the line. Photocurrent went up from the Mn-rich end to the 1:1 composition, which is where the BaMnO₃ phases sit, then fell to almost zero at Ba 0.61. That makes the 1:1 region the likely peak.

- **Why I chose index 20:** The trend from the first two points pointed toward more Ba, so I tested the Ba-rich side (near Ba₃Mn₂O₈). The GP model had suggested index 12 (Ba 0.40) instead. That choice didn't work out, and those unmeasured compositions between Ba 0.40 and 0.55 may be slightly better than index 5.
- **XRD:** I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements, so which phases are present is inferred from the known compounds, not confirmed.
